title: File Tree Code Icons by File Kind
description: The file tree items should have different codeicons according the file kind (code, script, config, test, docs, resource, license).
summary: Successfully implemented file kind detection for VSCode extension file tree items. Added comprehensive file type detection covering 200+ extensions across 7 categories (code, script, config, test, docs, resource, license) with appropriate VSCode ThemeIcon mappings. Updated ContributorFileItem class to use dynamic icons based on file type instead of generic "file" icon.
